repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhshTXCAmv9KJXRZkB ## 席位核对 · L1 (seat 3, L1-a) · 2026-11-17T04:47Z L1: REWORK Head-sha: fc84516beb2ecb6c5075ef1330fe6b44e9b847cf Card: #34580 · claim 6936534783 · os-dev-report 6937302384 The code, tests and every acceptance item hold. The one must-fix is a published doc sentence this PR makes false; the PR body already names it and leaves it for the seat. It is one sentence, so it goes in this PR. ### Must-fix 1. **`content/docs/automation/queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx:120` states the toggle on every list this PR withholds it from.** It reads: "In the Console, a list of an object that carries the `queue` column has an **In a queue** toggle in its toolbar." After this PR, a view whose own filter pins `owner_id` (`equals` / `in` / `is_not_empty` as a top-level AND conjunct) carries the column but has no toggle. HotCRM has 12 such view filters, so the published page becomes false where readers will look. The sentence also already omits the `hasAnyQueue` condition (#28889, 18.3 release notes). Checklist rule: a published defect this round makes false is fixed in the same PR, so the sentence gets both conditions now. For example: "…has an **In a queue** toggle in its toolbar when the organization has at least one queue and the view's own filter does not require an owner (`owner_id` equals, in, or is not empty)." - `content/docs/**` is outside the claim's file surface (`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/**`, root `.changeset/`). The seat amends the claim to add `content/docs/automation/queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx`, and the PR body's "Docs" acceptance note is replaced by a line naming the edit and the amendment. ### Should-fix None. ### Readings that hold | Item | Reading | |:--|:--| | PR shape | Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34580`; no other closing verb in the body (`#26359`, `#28428`, `#28889` appear only in the card, not the PR body). No `!`, no `(narrowing)`: no dogfood battery owed. `mergeable_state` clean. | | Scope | 3 files: `ListView.tsx`, `__tests__/ListView.harness.test.tsx`, `.changeset/34580-…md`, all inside the claim surface. Tests went into the shared harness file per AGENTS.md (declared deviation, correct). | | Published surface | `@object-ui/plugin-list` is published (no `private`; single `.` export → `dist/index`). `src/index.tsx` re-exports from `./ListView` only by name (`ListView`, `normalizeFilterCondition`, `normalizeFilters`, `LIST_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`, three types), not `export *`. The new `export function viewFilterRequiresOwner` is therefore module-visible only, not in the published accept set. `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` are right and match the claim. No contract face: L2 not owed. | | Changeset | Names `@object-ui/plugin-list` (the one package whose `src/**` moved). Sentences read against the diff:
• "toggle adds `owner_id is_empty` and `queue is_not_empty`" = `QUEUE_SITTING_CONDITIONS`.
• "withheld when … top-level AND condition on `owner_id` with `equals` (non-empty), `in` (list of non-empty) or `is_not_empty`" = `conjunctsOf` plus `requiresOwnerValue` over `canonicalAstOperator` (`=` with `isOwnerValue`, `in` with `every(isOwnerValue)`, `is_not_empty`).
• "inside an OR group does not count" = `isAstGroup(node,'or') → []`.
• "while withheld it adds nothing" = `appliedQueueSittingConditions` is gated on `queueFilterOffered`.
• "if it was on … turned off … shows it off" = the `useEffect` that calls `setSittingInQueueOnly(false)` on `viewPinsOwner`.
• "nothing changes on views without an owner condition" = the conjunct check returns false.
All true. | | Read point | `viewPinsOwner` reads `authoredFilter` (`ListView.tsx:2006`, `useResolvedFilter(schema.filter, filterScope)`), the same resolved filter the fetch reads, so `{current_user_id}` arrives as a value. It is declared before its use at `:2634`. | | Acceptance 1–4 | Met and pinned in `ListView.queueToggleOwnerPin-34580`:
• "My Open Deals": no toggle and no `is_empty` in the query.
• "All Opportunities": the toggle, and pressing it still ANDs both queue conditions.
• OR-group owner condition: keeps the toggle.
• One mount, filter changed by `rerender`: pressed, then pinned (no toggle, no hidden condition), then back with `aria-pressed="false"`.
Acceptance 3 (Leads / Cases with no owner condition still return queued rows) is the same code path as 2. | | Tests | Real commands with output (plugin-list 174 files / 1863 tests; `-t 34580` 6/6). Two ablations, each restored to the HEAD blob: dropping `!viewPinsOwner` turns the two pinned-view pins red; neutralising the reset turns the view-switch pin red. Both have controls that stay green. | | Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34623`: NOT governed, 0 of 3 paths, 222 lines. Tier S, lands through o3-C after the fix. | | CI on this head | 52 check-runs, all `success` or `skipped`. Test UI (aggregate plus 10 planned shards), Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Check Changeset, PR-body guards and Governed Surface Queue Guard are all `success`. | ### Notes - Per-object narrowing stays the maintainer's ruling, raised on the card. The dev's measurement (`hasAnyQueue` is the only client signal, org-wide) is a useful input for #34602 and needs no action here. - Declared deviations (attribution link to the card thread, relay trailer comment): no action. - After the docs push, send the new head: I owe a delta read (the docs sentence, the body line and the claim amendment), not a full re-review.

"and the view's own filter does not require `owner_id` to hold a value (a top-level `equals`, `in` or `is_not_empty` condition on it …; one inside an OR group does not count)" = `queueFilterOffered = hasAnyQueue === true && objectHasOwnershipQueue(objectDef) && !viewPinsOwner`, with `viewFilterRequiresOwner` taking the top-level AND's conjuncts (`conjunctsOf` returns none for an `or` node) and `requiresOwnerValue` matching `=` with a scalar, `in` with scalars, or `is_not_empty`. Every reading of 6938675239 other than the must-fix still holds at this head, since no code moved.

### Notes

1. **PR body.** The Docs acceptance note in the body still describes round 1. The requester's replacement text (round-2 note and gate block) is with the seat to apply; the landing area should see it applied before the merge. It changes no reading here.
2. main is 24 commits ahead with no conflict reported; the landing area's queue run reads the merged result.
